items.source: Note that this is a marker interface in the style of Serializable, semantically applying to a fragment implementation class. In other words, this marker applies to a particular repository composition that enables metadata access for the repository proxy when the composition contain fragments implementing this interface.
items.translation: 请注意，这是一个类似于 Serializable 风格的标记接口，语义上适用于片段实现类。换句话说，当组合中包含实现了此接口的片段时，该标记适用于特定的仓库组合，以便为仓库代理启用元数据访问。

items.source:
Ideally, in a repository composition only the fragment implementation uses this interface while the fragment
interface does not.
items.translation: 理想情况下，在仓库组合中，只有片段实现使用该接口，而片段接口本身则不使用。

items.source: Marker for repository fragment implementation that intend to access repository method invocation metadata.
items.translation: 用于标记旨在访问仓库方法调用元数据的仓库片段实现的注解。
